trusted_runner_harness_correction.previous_behavior: Before this material correction, the default suite selected C:\WINDOWS\system32\bash.EXE through shutil.which('bash'); eight trusted-runner tests then failed with E_ACCESSDENIED. A diagnostic-only PATH adjustment selecting Git Bash proved the intended tests passed, but was not credited as a default-environment result.
trusted_runner_harness_correction.intended_contract: The Manual Verification Bridge requires a Git Bash host (or another real Bash host with Git and Python); Windows bash.exe is the WSL launcher and is not that host.
trusted_runner_harness_correction.correction: The test harness now prefers the canonical Windows Git Bash paths before any ambiguous PATH result, with a Windows-specific regression that asserts C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe is selected when installed.
trusted_runner_harness_correction.current_evidence: The dedicated test passed and the current unmodified full suite passed with exit code 0. This is a narrowly scoped test-harness correction at the F-007 validation boundary, not a production policy weakening.

intentional_exception.reason: The narrowly necessary trusted-runner host-selection correction above; its regression and full-suite coverage are current.

limitations_and_open_authority: The original historical wheel archive bytes are not retained; only current reproducibility from authoritative PyPI artifacts is proven.
